Hi Irene — thanks for the follow-up and the controls mapping. Apologies for the delay. Quick update from our side:

- Legal wants a brief statement about encryption at rest for customer-owned keys vs. provider-managed keys — they asked for exact KMS options and whether HSM-backed keys are available.
- Security has one small ask around data retention: they want to confirm default retention plus an option for an account-level retention policy.

Neither of these are hard blockers, but they want the language clarified before moving to procurement. I’ll coordinate with our security lead and legal on timing — looks like we’ll have a clearer answer after our Friday meeting (May 7).

If you have a short sentence or two we can paste into the vendor intake, that would speed things up. Also happy to take the 30-min walkthrough you suggested — Tue, May 11 mid-morning PT looks possible.
